description: This file defines a Pango text provider for the Kivy framework, including classes for text rendering with Pango, font context management, and related methods. It integrates low-level Pango API calls and provides mechanisms for rendering text with Pango in Kivy applications.

classes.name: LabelPango
classes.description: A custom label class that uses Pango for text rendering within Kivy.

classes.name: PangoFontContextManager
classes.description: A font context manager class for handling font contexts with Pango in Kivy.

methods.name: add_font
methods.description: Adds a font file to a specified font context, handling file existence and resource finding.
